summary: Your web app keeps its familiar address, and old bookmarks work again.

fixes.title: The web app keeps its address
fixes.text: Every installation keeps its web app name and address. If it recently got a new address, it gets its earlier one back with the same settings and sign-in, checked before use.

fixes.title: Bookmarks work again at once
fixes.text: The recent address keeps working for a few days and sends visitors to the earlier address. Installations that never changed address are not touched.

fixes.title: Support tools report their changes correctly
fixes.text: A support tool now reports its changes correctly once they are made.
